summary: Tucked away on a peaceful cul-de-sac within the highly sought-after Eastbourne area, this delightful two-bedroom semi-detached home offers an inviting blend of comfort, convenience, and charm. Positioned on a generous corner plot along Claremont Road, the property boasts a good size front garden.
description:
Perfectly suited for first-time buyers, small families, or investors, this home is within easy reach of a wealth of local amenities. A selection of shops, well-regarded schools, and recreational facilities are just moments away, ensuring everyday essentials are easily accessible. The bustling town centre, filled with an array of restaurants, cafes, and entertainment options, is also nearby. For those who commute, the property is ideally situated close to the local train station, a principal stop on the East Coast Main Line. With direct services to London King's Cross, Newcastle, and Edinburgh, it offers seamless connectivity to major cities, making it a prime choice for professionals. Blending a fantastic location with the potential to create a warm and welcoming home, this property is a must-see for buyers looking for a well-connected and convenient lifestyle. The property briefly comprises of access via a upvc framed double glazed door into the well-appointed kitchen/dining room providing a range of fitted units, generous work surfaces, and space for dining, making it an ideal setting for both everyday meals and entertaining guests. Upstairs, there are two well-proportioned bedrooms, each offering plenty of space for furniture and storage. The family bathroom features a fitted white suite Externally, the property boasts a spacious frontage with a driveway providing off-road parking, secured by double gated access. The front garden is laid to lawn, enhancing the property's curb appeal. A gated side access leads to the generous rear garden, which is fully enclosed by fencing for privacy. The rear garden is predominantly laid to lawn, complemented by a gravelled section and a designated patio area, perfect for outdoor seating, relaxation, or entertaining.

ENTRANCE The entrance is accessed via a side upvc framed double glazed door leading into the kitchen.

LOUNGE The lounge is a bright and spacious living area, enhanced by a large UPVC framed double-glazed bay window, allowing plenty of natural light to flood the room. A second UPVC framed double-glazed window to the front aspect adds to the airy feel. The focal point of the room is a feature fire surround, creating a warm and inviting ambiance. A radiator ensures comfort throughout the seasons, making this a perfect space for relaxation or entertaining.

KITCHEN / DINER The kitchen is well-equipped with a range of fitted base and wall units, providing ample storage space. The laminate work surfaces are both practical and stylish, complemented by an inset sink unit with a mixer tap. Tiling to both the splashbacks and work surfaces adds to the modern appeal. There is space for a cooker with an extractor fan positioned overhead, perfect for cooking and ventilation. The room also offers enough space for a dining table and chairs, making it an ideal spot for family meals. A wall-mounted combination gas central heating boiler is conveniently located, ensuring warmth throughout the home. Additional under-stair storage is available, and the room is brightened by a UPVC framed double-glazed window, offering views of the rear garden.

FIRST FLOOR LANDING The first floor landing is a welcoming space that provides access to all the bedrooms and the family bathroom. The area is bright and airy, offering a smooth flow between the rooms. With convenient access to the bedrooms, it serves as a central hub for the upper level of the home.

BEDROOM ONE Bedroom one is a comfortable and well-lit room, featuring a UPVC framed double-glazed window that allows plenty of natural light to fill the space. A radiator ensures warmth throughout the year, creating a cosy atmosphere. This room offers a peaceful retreat, ideal for rest and relaxation.

BEDROOM TWO Bedroom two is another well-proportioned room, featuring a UPVC framed double-glazed window that brings in natural light and offers pleasant views of the surrounding area. A radiator provides efficient heating, ensuring the room remains comfortable throughout the year. This bedroom is versatile and would make a great guest room, home office, or child's bedroom.

FAMILY BATHROOM The bathroom is fitted with a modern white suite, including a panel bath with an inset wall-mounted electric shower, providing both comfort and convenience. The wash hand basin and WC are neatly integrated, with tasteful tiling to the splash and vanity areas, enhancing the overall appearance. A radiator ensures the room remains warm and cosy, while the UPVC framed double-glazed window allows natural light to brighten the space, creating a fresh and airy atmosphere.

EXTERNALLY Externally, to the front of the property, there is gated access leading onto a driveway, providing off-road parking. The front garden is laid to lawn, offering a welcoming first impression. To the side, a gate provides access to the rear garden. The rear garden is mainly laid to lawn, with a gravelled area and a paved patio, perfect for outdoor seating and entertaining. The garden is well-enclosed, offering privacy and a peaceful outdoor space to enjoy throughout the year.
